reuse_policy: Prefer structurally complete native units matching the frozen prompt; otherwise reuse compatible historical native units with original prompt/model provenance. Bind to identical fact evidence and identical task-requirement ID semantics. Never rank by benchmark score or semantic correctness.
reused_packet_projection: Select unchanged native units from original complete response; archive both. Not a model rerun, quotation repair, or new annotation.
failure_policy: No automatic retries/repair/review. Preserve failures and missing coverage explicitly. Continue other traces unless provider/service identity failure.
incomplete_output_policy: Missing/failed annotations remain explicit; all recorded facts and raw unsuccessful responses retained. No synthetic annotation to claim completion.
